violations.text: Cases of canned vegetables and fruit were observed stored on the floor in the dry storage area. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 09/12/2024

The cabinet of the sink in the rear of the kitchen is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. Inspector observed rotted wood and a hole in the cabinet. New Violation. Correct By: 10/10/2024
